name: coredns_forward_plugin_servfail_rate_high
title: CoreDNS Forward Plugin SERVFAIL Rate High
description: CoreDNS is returning SERVFAIL of requests forwarded to upstream, indicating the upstream resolver is unhealthy.

source.upstream_alert: CoreDNS Forward Plugin SERVFAIL Rate High
source.upstream_query: sum without (pod, instance, rcode) (rate(coredns_forward_responses_total{rcode="SERVFAIL"}[5m])) / sum without (pod, instance, rcode) (rate(coredns_forward_responses_total[5m])) > 0.01
source.upstream_description: CoreDNS is returning SERVFAIL for {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of requests forwarded to upstream {{ $labels.to }}, indicating the upstream resolver is unhealthy.

query_condition.promql: sum without (pod, instance, rcode) (rate(coredns_forward_responses_total{rcode="SERVFAIL"}[5m])) / sum without (pod, instance, rcode) (rate(coredns_forward_responses_total[5m]))
